description: resolve_protocol_call miss-path: for each (protocol,target) provider whose target overlaps the receiver, demand DefineModule(reference_protocol_impl_module(protocol,target)) instead of DefineModule(provider). Removes the 'define the whole host module' indirection. Signal: the Mini fixture (.12/.15) resolves by defining only Susp.List, not Mini. Depends on T1.

comments.text: Merged into T1 (fz-hwn.19.2.4.16.1): registering a defimpl as an independent Protocol.Target module and having dispatch demand it directly are one atomic change — root-level defimpls break in the interim otherwise. Closing as merged.

title: Dispatch demands the impl module Protocol.Target directly, not the host module
